$comment: Documented exceptions for the npm audit gate (scripts/security/npm-audit-gate.js). Each entry MUST include a justification. Only advisories with no upstream fix may be listed here.

allowlist.title: SheetJS Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
allowlist.justification: No upstream fix available (SheetJS ceased publishing fixed versions to the public npm registry; advisory affects all published versions). xlsx is only used to parse spreadsheet files uploaded by authenticated users in an authenticated server-side context, not on untrusted public input, so ReDoS exposure is limited. Replacement with an actively maintained spreadsheet library is tracked as follow-up work.
